contract.atomicFactSet: complete PeopleCandidateDraft + typed Candidate head + initial immutable `open` revision + durable typed result + commit marker + People-internal Outbox
contract.rollbackInvariant: Any participant, revision fence, digest, or CAS failure leaves zero transaction writes visible; no commit marker, receipt, or outbox may survive alone.

crashFixtures.faultInjectionPoints: typed Evidence恢复、Resolver产出complete Draft、Candidate head/open revision/typed Result/marker各边界；用户或strong rule接受前后；Registration Person/alias/provider identity与Merge target/source/preference/correlation提交各边界
crashFixtures.requiredInvariant: CommitParticipant不旁读Foundation/Provider；Candidate payload digest可重算；重启不丢open Candidate；candidate revision或任一Person/Preference revision变化时整体CAS失败；接受成功时Candidate terminal与全部Person facts同时成立，同marker重放返回同一typed Result；弱Identity未经用户确认不建立Person，Preference冲突不得strong-rule自动接受
